steps.name: sync-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "9ed643b046ee213b6ebc56b849cb9c91911dcc85"; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "9ed643b046ee213b6ebc56b849cb9c91911dcc85"

steps.name: recover-wireless-s22
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; rm -f /tmp/aicall-wireless-selector; adb start-server >/dev/null; for E in $(adb mdns services 2>/dev/null | awk '/_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $NF}'); do adb connect "$E" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; sleep 2; SEL=''; for D in $(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); do case "$D" in *:*) M="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; if [ "$M" = SM-S906B ] && [ "$S" = RFCT70L7E8J ]; then SEL="$D"; break; fi;; esac; done; test -n "$SEL" || { echo 'verified_wireless_s22_not_found=true' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$SEL" >/tmp/aicall-wireless-selector; echo 'verified_wireless_s22=true'

steps.name: require-idle-and-readiness
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; SEL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-wireless-selector)"; STATE="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<PY
from aicall_tools.device.s22_call_control import Adb
print(Adb('$SEL').call_state())
PY
)"; test "$STATE" = 0 || { echo "call_state_not_idle=$STATE" >&2; exit 3; }; echo 'call_state_idle=true'; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"
